remarks:
Sophistication and elegance define this stunning newly constructed Marrano Homes patio home model in Lockhaven Estates. Thoughtfully designed with custom tray ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors, quartz countertops, ceramic tile accents, and beautifully appointed finishes throughout. The open-concept design features a bright sunroom with a cozy fireplace and expansive windows, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining.

The gourmet kitchen is a true showpiece, featuring tall cabinetry with crown molding, undermount lighting, quartz countertops, and a ceramic tile backsplash. All appliances and window treatments are included. The spacious primary suite offers a private retreat with a generous walk-in closet and spa-inspired bath complete with double sinks, ceramic shower with bench seating, and frameless glass door.

Enjoy the ease of low-maintenance living with landscaping and snow removal handled by the homeowners association. A beautifully appointed Marrano patio home offering style, comfort, and effortless living in Lockhaven Estates. Taxes TBD.
